title: Acceptance probability of the affine subspace system
statement: Let $n$ be positive, let $V$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$, let $a\in\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $w\in\{0,1\}^n$ and $p\in\{0,1\}^{2^n}$. The acceptance probability of the affine subspace PCPP system on input $w$ and proof $p$ is the average of the acceptance probabilities of its affine-subspace proof tester and its affine-consistency tester, each applied to the combined input and proof word.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$
$w$ is a Boolean word of length $n$
$p$ is a Boolean proof word of length $2^n$
